dialogues.speaker: Ajaw
dialogues.text: Hah, all eyes are on me! Lowly servants, behold the Almighty Dragonlord's magnificence!

dialogues.speaker: Kinich
dialogues.text: Yeah, a loud, glowing bug... Not something you see every day.

dialogues.speaker: Ajaw
dialogues.text: Kiniiiiiich! I dare you to say that again!
